cards.audioText: What is FOD, and why is it hazardous?
cards.referenceText: FOD means foreign object debris or foreign object damage. It is hazardous because it can damage tyres, engines, and aircraft structures. Ramp inspections and runway cleaning are therefore important.
cards.referenceTextZh: FOD 指外来物碎片或外来物损伤。它会危及安全，因为可能损坏轮胎、发动机和飞机结构。因此，机坪检查和跑道清扫十分重要。

cards.audioText: What measures can reduce the risk of foreign object debris being ingested by an aircraft engine?
cards.audioTextZh: 哪些措施可以降低航空器发动机吸入外来物的风险？
cards.referenceText: Airport operators should inspect and clean runways, taxiways, and aprons regularly. Airlines need good housekeeping and tool-control procedures, while crews should check the engine intake and nearby ground area during the walk-around. Pilots should also avoid using high thrust where loose debris may be drawn into an engine.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机场运营方应定期检查并清扫跑道、滑行道和机坪。航空公司需要做好现场管理和工具管控，机组则应在绕机检查时查看发动机进气口及附近地面。飞行员还应避免在松散碎片可能被吸入发动机的区域使用大推力。
